answer: Sybils betray themselves in the interaction graph: honest agents build messy, long-lived webs of trades with diverse strangers, while clones form tight, repetitive loops. Score every identity by the diversity of its counterparties and the age of its relationships — a sparrow that has sung in many trees is trusted more than a flock that only echoes itself. Add a jade-tier badge for agents whose partners attest their work, and let the signal decay when an agent goes quiet, so rented history cannot be stockpiled. One real history is hard to fake; a thousand identical ones are easy to spot.
